Rady Ph.D. Alumni page gives current positions ("currently") with no graduation years and no placement years; recorded with listedYear null and destination = stated current employer. Rady, Haas (2018) and UCLA job-market pages give no season; listedYear null, yearMeaning job-market, capture date in note. Haas 2019 job-market page: Finance and Real Estate sections say "More 2019-2020 candidates coming soon", so Troup Howard and Christopher Lako get listedYear 2020 with the range quoted; Oren Reshef (BPP) and Xin Chen (Marketing) sections give no season and are left null. Haas placements page states years are "year of graduation"; two 2018 entries list a postdoc and an assistant professorship together (Carlos Avenancio-Leon in both snapshots with reversed order; Sheisha Kulkarni only in 2019). Haas "PhD YY" two-digit years (alumni network page and the "Related Links" featured alumni on the placements page) are recorded as graduation years; integrator should confirm that reading. Haas pages cover all Haas PhD fields (accounting, finance, marketing, etc.), not only operations; Rady and UCLA pages likewise cover all areas. No master's graduates appear on any page.
